_readme: Hand-edited fields for the website catalog. Facts (modality, species, stimuli, dataset, architecture) come from berg/models/model_cards/*.yaml; this file holds readable titles, short labels, grouping and snippets. Run scripts/website/build_catalog.py after editing. snippet_verified is false or a hash written by scripts/website/verify_snippets.py --write; never edit it by hand.
